environment.description: EKS cluster v1.28, pod deployed in namespace 'data-pipeline' with service account 'task-processor-sa'. Pod runs with default security context. Istio sidecar injected with PERMISSIVE mTLS mode (PeerAuthentication set to PERMISSIVE at mesh level). No AuthorizationPolicy resources applied to the namespace. NetworkPolicy allows all ingress to port 50051 from any namespace. Pod has hostNetwork: false but no additional network restrictions. Service exposed via ClusterIP on port 50051.
